notes.title: Anima: Gate of Memories I & II Remaster – An Action-RPG Saga Reforged
notes.content:
This release rebuilds Gate of Memories and The Nameless Chronicles from the ground up, with enhanced visuals, rebalanced combat, and gameplay improvements on a single new title. Whether you're a longtime fan or discovering Gaia for the first time, this is the ultimate way to experience the saga.

Prepare to (re)discover the world of Gaia, the way it's meant to be experienced!

Coming later this year!

WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592140/Anima_Gate_of_Memories_I__II_Remastered/

Watch the Reveal Trailer:

[previewyoutube=q6XSK6Vjtio;full][/previewyoutube]

UPTATE CHANGES
Also, along with the announcement, we have done several general bug-fixing of the current version of Anima, to make the game more stable and improve performance.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE SKINS!
notes.content:
To celebrate Halloween, we want to announce the release of two new spooky skins for the characters, Dark Witch Bearer and Undead Lord Ergo. Both will be available for free in the Skin Menu from the beginning. We hope that you will love them!

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Patch Notes Anima Gate Of Memories 1.04
notes.content:
Fixed a bug tracking some achievements.
Kappel can no longer be stunlocked using the launcher multiple times.
Some intagible walls are being corrected.
Malekith Clones no longer poison you.
Some minor issues in the lost wing are corrected.

notes.title: Patch Notes Anima Gate of Memories 1.02
notes.content:
Now the Windowed version is borderless and the mouse is constrained to not leave the game.
Experience gain is no longer shown before you are really able to gain experience.
Fixed a bug that could cause the player to fall under the ground.
Fixed a bug that moved the player towards a pushable item when the player jumps away.
Fixed a bug that allowed to player to go over the roof of the Cathedral.
Fixed a bug that caused the Bearer's model to stay when the player Skiped the conversation in the mansion.

notes.title: Design a tarot card and win big prizes!
notes.content:
To celebrate the future release of Anima: Gate of Memories on PS4 boxed, we are inviting you to join in our online competition by designing your own tarot card in the style of Anima.

To qualify for entry, applicants must SUBMIT their artwork to us (on Grandyo https://www.grandyo.com/challenge-15 & SHARE their artwork on social media and include the hashtags #AnimaGOM @animaps @BadlandIndie along with the title.

All submitted entries that comply with the rules can be voted on. 

Rules:

- Submitted artwork must be the applicants own.
- Applicants must be 12 or over to enter.
- You are prohibited to send in any submission that is deemed too "pornographic"

Tips
- Get creative. Have a look on the internet for inspiration on current tarot cards. 
- Watch the Anima: Gate of Memories trailer to get an idea of their style. http://badlandindie.com/anima-gate-of-memories/ 
- Send in your artwork and get your friends, family and anyone you know to vote for you.
